semiconductor_relevance: High — TGV Circuits specializes in advanced packaging substrates for semiconductor applications, particularly in 2.5D/3D chiplet designs.
summary: TGV Circuits Co., Ltd. focuses on the development of glass-based TGV multilayer precision circuit boards and packaging technologies for semiconductor applications. Their products are crucial for high-performance computing markets, including AI, supercomputers, and data centers, as well as sensing technologies and RF devices for 6G communication.
capabilities: Glass-based TGV multilayer precision circuit boards
Advanced packaging substrates for 2.5D/3D chiplet designs
